A vane-type stirrer with strong circulation power gives optimal temperature equilibrium, and microprocessor PID control with automatic tuning and calibration holds +/- 0.1 C at 50 C across an ambient +5 to 150 C range.

Double tempered safety-glass windows on the front and rear provide clear visibility for reading viscometer tubes, and an isolated agitator, heater and sensor design minimises turbulence and protects users and samples.
